source: Fux, The Study of Counterpoint (trans. Mann, 1965), p. 32, Fig. 7: why direct motion into a perfect consonance is forbidden
transcription: Sounding pitches as MIDI numbers, durations in beats. Left: a third to a fifth in direct motion (figures 3 5). Right, 'Resolution': the lower voice's leap filled in (diminution), which shows the fifths: F-B flat, then E-A (figures 5 5).
